title: COSUIZA — Corpus de documentos hispánicos de Suiza
institution: GRAFILA (Grupo de Análisis Filológico de Lausana), Section d'espagnol, Université de Lausanne; CHARTA network member
region: Documents kept in Swiss archives (Basel, Fribourg, Bern, Geneva, Valais, Vaud, Lausanne), written mostly in Spain and Spanish America
notes: 123 TEITOK documents (stats page 'action=stats', checked 2026-10-12): non-literary manuscripts edited following the CHARTA criteria (palaeographic and critical presentation, TEI XML with lemma/POS). Word and text counts are left out: only 53 of the 123 documents carry a date in their TEI header (1483-1951), of which at least 27 (about 9,400 tokens) fall within 1450-1700; the share of the 70 undated documents is unknown, and the corpus is under construction. Raw TEI XML is served per document. Part of the CHARTA network.
license_note: TEI header availability statement only says 'Licencia CREATIVE COMMONS' without naming the variant.
